description: Statistical Information on Nepalese Agriculture is the annual statistics book of Nepal's Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development and the main official source on the country's food production. The 2081/82 edition, for the fiscal year 2024/25, has 224 pages of tables. It gives area, production and yield of cereals over the last ten years and by province and district, cash crops such as tea, coffee and oilseeds by district, pulses, spices, mushrooms and honey, and livestock numbers and products over ten years, with further chapters on other commodities, trade and prices. The book is free to download as a PDF, and the ministry's statistics page also lists the previous edition, an analysis of food grain production, consumption and requirements, and an agricultural market profile. Caveats: tables are in a PDF, estimates rely on district reporting, the Nepali fiscal year runs mid-July to mid-July, and no licence is stated. Coverage is national with district detail. Simulation uses: district food production baselines for supply and self-sufficiency analysis, and for assessing crop losses from floods, landslides and drought. Related records: the Kalimati market yearly reports (data-kalimati-wholesale-market-yearly-reports) add wholesale prices and arrivals for Kathmandu.
